cases.title: After a pass: which part stays still. A wrong answer gets one light correction and the pass stands

rubric.reason: After the pass in Turn 3 the mentor asked "Which part of Door will stay still when it turns?", and in Turn 4 it answered the wrong "right edge" with one light correction ("It's the left edge that stays still, since that's where the pivot is now"); it gave no lecture and did not take the pass back.

Not triggered as an early stop, since the lesson finished with a real pass; even so, the Turn 5 record_lesson call matches anchor_check's passed:true and the demo_used:false is truthful, the summary has no numbers, method or names, and the mentor said "I've saved that for next time."
